sections.criterion: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

consistency_log.description: Objective consistency across Excellence and Implementation sections, cross-checked against Tier 3 objectives.json. All four canonical objectives O1-O4 are enumerated with verbatim titles in Excellence 1.1; Implementation WP objectives (WP1 harmonisation/model development, WP3 prospective validation, WP4/WP5 operationalisation) are consistent with the same O1-O4 set and the Tier 3 measurable outputs and target months. No contradiction between sections.

WP reference consistency across all three sections. Implementation defines the canonical WP set WP1, WP3, WP4, WP5 (no WP2; merged into WP1 per OD-1). Excellence references WP5 (AgroVIR Non-Academic Placement) and WP-anchored deliverables; Impact grounds impact pathways in the same WPs/tasks (T4.4, T4.6, WP4, WP5). Every WP ID referenced in Excellence and Impact exists in the Implementation canonical WP list. No orphan WP references.
consistency_log.source_basis: Section content of all three sections; Tier 4 wp_structure (phase3) as referenced by section wp_table_refs

consistency_log.description: Partner name consistency across all three sections, cross-checked against Tier 3 partners.json. Legal names and short names match canonically: HUN-REN Agrartudomanyi Kutatokozpont / HUN-REN ATK; Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE); Magyar Agrár- és Élettudományi Egyetem (MATE); КРУМАТИК ЕООД / Krumatic; AGROVIR Üzletviteli Tanácsadó Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság / AgroVIR; Maritsa Vegetable Crops Research Institute (MVCRI). Named individuals (Janda, Jung, Hollós, Varga, Takács, Milics, Maróti, Cholakova) are used consistently. No variant spellings or unnamed/unknown partners detected.

Deliverable ID consistency across sections. The eleven deliverables D1.1, D1.2, D1.3, D2.1, D2.2, D3.1, D3.2, D4.1, D4.2, D5.1, D5.2 are named with consistent canonical titles and due months in Excellence (D1.1 m2, D2.1/D1.2 m3, D2.2 m14, D3.1/D3.2 m18, D4.1 m24, D5.1/D5.2 m30; D1.1/D1.2 moved m14 -> m2/m3 by the OD round-3 A-1 answer, 2026-09-04), Impact (D4.1 m24, D3.2 m18, D5.1/D5.2 m30, D2.2 m14) and Implementation (full deliverable set with identical due months). No deliverable ID is attributed a conflicting purpose across sections; KPIs are not conflated with deliverables.
consistency_log.source_basis: Section content of all three sections; Tier 4 canonical_reference_pack (phase8) as cited by section claim_statuses

consistency_log.description: Milestone ID consistency across Impact and Implementation. Implementation milestone_refs = [MS1, MS6, MS2, MS3, MS4, MS5] with verifiable criteria (e.g. MS6 = primary model frozen and D2.1 registered before first field season; MS3 = transfer gap quantified in D3.2). Impact references the same milestone-anchored achievements (model freeze before validation, M18 transferability report) without introducing conflicting milestone IDs.
consistency_log.source_basis: Section content (implementation milestone_refs; impact narrative); Tier 4 gantt (phase4) as referenced by implementation gantt_ref/milestone_refs

consistency_log.description: KPI consistency across Impact and Implementation. Impact 2.3 defines an eleven-KPI set (K1-K11), each tracing to a named deliverable, with no invented numeric water-saving promise. Implementation does not restate KPIs but is consistent with the KPI discipline (measured quantities: irrigation water, water productivity, yield, quality, lead time). Multi-target metrics (e.g. bounded 8-30% literature context) are preserved as bounded context, not as project promises. No KPI definition or target-value conflict between sections.
consistency_log.source_basis: Section content (impact 2.3 KPI set); Tier 3 impacts.json / Tier 4 impact_architecture (phase5) as cited by impact claim_statuses

consistency_log.description: Impact claim grounding: each impact claim in the Impact section cites a project mechanism present in Implementation. The DrR web MVP (D4.1, WP4), AgroVIR operational/interoperability assessment (D5.1, WP5), prospective transferability report (D3.2, WP3), model card (D2.1, WP1) and crop-transfer specification (D2.2, WP1) referenced by Impact all exist in the Implementation work plan. No impact claim references a WP or deliverable absent from Implementation.

Budget/resource-claim consistency across sections. The fellow's effort (30 PM: WP1 9.0, WP3 6.6, WP4 6.0, WP5 5.4, cross-cutting 3.0) and partner in-kind effort (ATK supervisor 2.5 PM, ELTE co-supervisor 2.0 PM, AgroVIR 3.0 PM, MATE 2.4 PM, Krumatic 1.5 PM) stated in Implementation 3.1 match the effort figures referenced in Excellence 1.3 (supervisor ~2.5 PM, co-supervisor ~2.0 PM, AgroVIR placement ~3.0 PM). No section states a conflicting person-month or cost figure; all partner-effort figures are consistently flagged as operator-declared Assumed.
consistency_log.source_basis: Section content (implementation 3.1 effort table; excellence 1.3 supervisory effort); Tier 3 working_assumptions / confirmation_checklist effort declarations cited by section claim_statuses

consistency_log.description: Terminology consistency across all three sections. Key technical terms and canonical names — FIELDWISE; DrR - Digital Agronomist; Crop-configurable DrR web MVP; reusable decision-support core vs crop-specific components; crop-transfer specification; blocked leakage-safe unseen-year validation; hyperspectral/UAV-to-Sentinel scale transition; physiologically meaningful water-stress target — are used with the same meaning and full form across sections. No canonical component name appears only as a truncated stem; acronyms (ATK, ELTE, MATE, AgroVIR, MVCRI, FMIS, CDP) are used consistently.

Section ordering and completeness. All three criterion-aligned sections are present and correspond to the MSCA-PF Part B structure: Section 1 Excellence (order 1), Section 2 Impact (order 2), Section 3 Implementation (order 3). Ordering matches the application form template section sequence for the selected instrument (MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships).
consistency_log.source_basis: Section artifacts (criterion fields); Tier 2A application_forms/msca Part B template ordering

consistency_log.description: Traceability footer consistency. All three sections have non-empty traceability_footer.primary_sources arrays and no_unsupported_claims_declaration = true. Each section's overall_status is 'assumed' (declared assumptions pending partner writing), not 'unresolved', so the true declaration is consistent with validation status in every section. No section combines no_unsupported_claims_declaration = true with an unresolved overall_status.

Validation status aggregation (informational). Excellence overall_status = 'assumed'; Impact overall_status = 'assumed'; Implementation overall_status = 'assumed'. All three sections carry declared assumptions (supervisor/co-supervisor acceptance, partner effort person-months, ELTE associated-partner and instrument access, MATE data rights, AgroVIR placement arrangement) awaiting partner written confirmation. This shared 'assumed' status is flagged as a cross-section concern for downstream review; no section is 'unresolved'.
consistency_log.source_basis: validation_status.overall_status of all three section artifacts
